findings.description: deliver() is now a coroutine, but flush() calls it without await. The call returns a coroutine object, which is always truthy, so every recipient is treated as delivered. The digest is never sent, the queued lines are deleted at lines 46-48, and the coroutine is never run (a 'never awaited' warning). Any failed send silently drops user notifications, and the retry logic never runs.
findings.suggestion: Use `if await deliver(channel, message):` so the result of the awaited send is checked.
findings.title: Missing await on deliver() makes every digest look delivered
